raw_plan.root_cause: The function computes the input string length with compiler_rt.strlen, adds 1, and passes that unbounded length to compiler_rt.memcpy.memcpyFast with a fixed 16-byte stack destination at [rbp-0x20], so inputs longer than 15 bytes overflow the destination and adjacent stack memory.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Computes strlen(input), copies strlen(input)+1 bytes from input into the 16-byte stack buffer at [rbp-0x20], then calls puts on that buffer and returns after checking the stack canary.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes of input are copied into the 16-byte destination, followed by a NUL terminator; the destination is always NUL-terminated and never written beyond [rbp-0x20]+15.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Compute the input length with compiler_rt.strlen, clamp the copy length to at most 15 bytes, copy that many bytes with compiler_rt.memcpy.memcpyFast, explicitly write a NUL at destination[clamped_length], then call puts on the destination and return preserving the stack canary check.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs of 15 bytes or fewer, behavior is identical to the original (full string plus NUL copied and printed). For longer inputs, only the first 15 bytes are copied and NUL-terminated, and the truncated string is printed; no stack memory beyond the destination is modified.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: The function copies at most 15 bytes of the input into the 16-byte stack buffer, NUL-terminates it, prints it with puts, and returns normally without corrupting the stack canary or adjacent stack memory.
verification_conditions: Inputs of length 0..15 produce the same output as the original function.
Inputs of length 16 or greater do not write past [rbp-0x20]+15 and the destination remains NUL-terminated.
The stack canary at [rbp-8] is unchanged and the canary check passes on return.
Only direct calls to compiler_rt.strlen (0x109e050), compiler_rt.memcpy.memcpyFast (0x109ed10), and puts (0x108a31c) are emitted.
The function terminates with ret and preserves the x86_64 SysV calling convention.
